description: Replication Data: Measuring the Resilience of Bike-Sharing Systems Under Three Disruption Types is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sorath Shah (Masaryk univer). Replication Package, City-Day Segmented Demand Series (Five Cities, Three Disruption Types) City-day demand series supporting:"Measuring the Resilience of Bike-Sharing Systems Under Different Disruptions: Counterfactual Evidence From Five European Cities". Produced within ROMSUR, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (Horizon Europe, Grant Agreement 101102858), Masaryk University, Brno. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
